caption: Helsingør Harbour, Helsingør
composition: Working harbour basin with Kronborg small on the point · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the south quay, Helsingør harbour is a working basin of fishing boats and one plain ferry, and Kronborg's sandstone walls and copper roofs sit small on the point to the north. The quay is empty. It is light drizzle, about 13.9°C. The wind is light, about 12.2 km/h. Light drizzle is falling. The cloud deck hides the moon. Quay lamps light the damp concrete. This is not the close seaward view of the castle.
